parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: The reaction between $\mathbf{W}$ and alkaline aqueous iodine produces a yellow precipitate.
parts.text: Give the name of the compound formed as a yellow precipitate in this reaction.

parts.label: (b)
(c)(i)
parts.text: Identify the type of reaction occurring in reaction 1.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem: Reaction 2 is carried out by adding a mixture of $\text{HCN}$ and $\text{NaCN}$ to $\mathbf{W}$. The product, $\mathbf{X}$, is formed as a mixture of two isomers.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: State the name of the type of isomerism shown by $\mathbf{X}$.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text: Explain fully why $\mathbf{X}$ shows this type of isomerism.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.stem: If $\mathbf{X}$ is treated with ammonia and the product hydrolysed, a compound, $\mathbf{Y}$, is obtained that contains 51.3% C, 9.40% H, 12.0% N and 27.3% O by mass.
parts.text: Show that the empirical formula of $\mathbf{Y}$ is $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{11}\text{NO}_2$.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text:
The empirical formula of $\mathbf{Y}$ is $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{11}\text{NO}_2$ and the $M_{\text{r}}$ of $\mathbf{Y}$ is 117.

Deduce the molecular formula of $\mathbf{Y}$. You **must** explain your reasoning.
